comparison.objective: Place ballast to balance a payload deck within 5 mm; candidate adjusts damping to achieve safe repeatable stops.
comparison.physical_skill: Mass-aware block placement versus fine rotary tool adjustment, bounded tightening, control actuation, and dynamic observation.
comparison.success_condition: Combined center of mass within 5 mm versus stroke, velocity, energy, rebound, overload, hard-stop, and drift criteria.
comparison.reason: Static balancing does not test adjustment-lock retention or dynamic energy absorption.
